name: snes9xtyl
notes: Media Engine build of Snes9xTYL with RetroShell's adapter: the L+R+Select (or HOME) pause surface, Emulator Settings opening Snes9xTYL's own menu, the shared save library and Exit returning to RetroShell.
localPatches: Copy native-emulators/sdk/retroshell_adapter.[ch] and src/core_api/rs_pause_menu.h into psp/ before building
Build with `make mehome`, then `make` in psp/homehookprx and psp/mediaengineprx
psp/psp.cpp: L+R+Select (and HOME) open the RetroShell-ordered pause surface drawn with Snes9xTYL's pg primitives; Emulator Settings opens root_menu()
psp/psp.cpp, psp/psp_state.c: battery saves in RetroShell's per-game save folder, states/previews/cheats in states/snes9xtyl/, with read-only fallback to the standalone SAVES folder
psp/psp.cpp: rs_adapter_return() after the emulation thread has saved and stopped the Media Engine
makefile_multi: compile the adapter shim and link pspsystemctrl_user
